$comment: Every string the player reads. Ids are stable and describe what the text is for; {name} marks a value filled in by the game. To translate, copy this file and keep the ids.
stat.strength.name: Strength
stat.strength.description: Raw physical power: melee weapons add its modifier to hit and to damage, and heavy armour needs it. Points on gear also lengthen your swing.
stat.dexterity.name: Dexterity
stat.dexterity.description: Agility and reflexes: ranged and finesse weapons add its modifier to hit and to damage, and it raises your Armor Class (fully in light armour, up to +2 in medium).
stat.constitution.name: Constitution
stat.constitution.description: Toughness and stamina: your modifier adds to your hit points every level and to each hit die you spend. Points on gear let you sprint for longer.
stat.intelligence.name: Intelligence
stat.intelligence.description: Reasoning and arcane skill: your Fire Bolt adds its modifier to hit.
stat.wisdom.name: Wisdom
stat.wisdom.description: Awareness and insight. It has no effect yet.
stat.charisma.name: Charisma
stat.charisma.description: Force of personality. Each point on gear makes enemies drop 5% more coins.
slot.head: Head
sheet.ac.name: Armor Class
sheet.ac.description: How hard you are to hit: a blow lands when the attacker's d20 roll plus their bonus reaches your AC. With no armour it is 10 + your DEX modifier. Armour sets its own base instead (light adds all of DEX, medium at most +2, heavy none), a shield adds +2 and a Fighter's Defense style +1 in armour.
sheet.hp.name: Hit Points
sheet.hp.description: How much harm you can take before you fall. In the tabletop game your class's hit die decides it (a d10 a level for a Fighter, a d6 for a Wizard, plus CON); here every hero has five times the tabletop number.
sheet.proficiency.name: Proficiency Bonus
sheet.proficiency.description: Added to attacks with weapons you are trained in, to your spells, and to the two saving throws your class is trained in. It grows with level: +2 at levels 1-4, +3 at 5-8, and so on.
sheet.initiative.name: Initiative
sheet.initiative.description: Who acts first when a fight breaks out. You and the foe that found you each roll d20 + your initiative (the DEX modifier, and what your class and feats add), shown over your heads; the higher roll wins the FIRST STRIKE: its next attack rolls with advantage (two d20s, the better one counts).
sheet.speed.name: Speed
sheet.speed.description: How far you move in a round, in feet. Heavy armour you lack the STR for slows you by 10 ft.
sheet.speed.slowed: {armor} is too heavy for you: -10 ft
sheet.passive.name: Passive Perception
sheet.passive.description: What you notice without searching: 10 + your WIS modifier. Hidden foes and traps at or under it are spotted.
sheet.hit_dice.name: Hit Dice
sheet.hit_dice.description: One die a level, by class. Click to spend one and heal: roll it and add your CON modifier. Spend them while no enemy is hunting you (in the tabletop game, during a short rest); a long rest gives back half of them.
sheet.hit_dice.none: None left: a long rest gives some back
sheet.xp.name: Experience
sheet.xp.description: Every enemy defeated gives experience points by its challenge rating (shared out among the party). Enough of them and you go up a level: more hit points, another hit die, a better proficiency bonus every four levels, and new spells.
sheet.spell.name: Spellcasting
sheet.spell.description: Your spells hit on d20 + proficiency + your casting ability. A spell a foe resists makes them beat your spell save DC: 8 + proficiency + that ability. There are no spell slots: each spell needs a while to recover after it is cast, and a short rest recovers them all.
sheet.spell.untrained: Not a caster: Intelligence stands in
sheet.saves.name: Saving Throws
sheet.saves.description: Rolled to resist poison, spells and traps: d20 + the ability's modifier, plus your proficiency bonus for the two your class is trained in (in gold).
sheet.dmg.name: Weapon Damage
sheet.dmg.description: What a hit with your weapon deals: its dice plus a modifier. Melee weapons add STR, ranged ones DEX, and finesse weapons (dagger, shortsword, scimitar...) the better of the two. A magic weapon adds its bonus to hit and to damage; a versatile one hits harder with the other hand free.
combat_log.title: COMBAT LOG
combat_log.toggle_aria: Show or hide the combat log
proficiency.title: {class} proficiencies
proficiency.armor_description: Your class decides which armour you are trained in. Wearing armour you are not trained in gives disadvantage on every attack roll: two d20s are rolled and the lower one counts.
proficiency.weapons_description: Simple weapons (clubs, daggers, spears, short bows) and martial ones (swords, axes, polearms, longbows). A weapon you are trained in adds your proficiency bonus (+2 at level 1) to hit; others don't.
hero.fighter.name: Fighter
hero.fighter.blurb: A veteran of a hundred sieges in plate and steel: the wall the party stands behind.
hero.wizard.name: Wizard
hero.wizard.blurb: A scholar of the arcane who learned fire and frost from old books and older ruins.
hero.rogue.name: Rogue
hero.rogue.blurb: A shadow with a blade, striking where it hurts most.
hero.warlock.name: Warlock
hero.warlock.blurb: She struck a bargain with something below the world, and its power answers her call.
hero.bard.name: Bard
hero.bard.blurb: A singer of old songs whose words mend allies and sting foes.
hero.fighter2.name: Fighter
hero.fighter2.blurb: A battle-hardened warrior at home in any armour and with any weapon.
hero.cleric.name: Cleric
hero.cleric.blurb: A crowned knight in a tattered cloak, a servant of the gods of life who mends wounds and smites in radiant light.
feature.sneak_attack.name: Sneak Attack
feature.sneak_attack.description: +1d6 damage with finesse or ranged weapons, one more die every two levels.
feature.jack_of_all_trades.name: Jack of All Trades
feature.jack_of_all_trades.description: Half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) is added to initiative.
feature.disciple_of_life.name: Disciple of Life
feature.disciple_of_life.description: Your healing spells mend 2 + the spell's level more.
feature.agonizing_blast.name: Agonizing Blast
feature.agonizing_blast.description: Eldritch Blast adds your CHA modifier to its damage.
feat.alert.name: Alert
feat.tough.name: Tough
feat.tough.description: +2 hit points every level (and for each level already gained).
style.archery.name: Archery
style.archery.description: +2 to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.
style.defense.name: Defense
style.defense.description: +1 Armor Class while you are wearing armour.
style.dueling.name: Dueling
style.dueling.description: +2 damage with a melee weapon held in one hand when you hold no other weapon (a shield is fine).
style.great_weapon_fighting.name: Great Weapon Fighting
style.great_weapon_fighting.description: When you roll a 1 or a 2 on a damage die with a melee weapon held in two hands (a two-handed or versatile weapon), you roll that die again and must use the new roll.
style.protection.name: Protection
style.protection.description: While you carry a shield, an enemy's attack on an ally within 5 feet of you is rolled with disadvantage. A passive: it needs 5 seconds to recover, and with several allies near it covers the closest.

level.scores.title: Ability scores
level.scores.hint: Buy your scores now. Every hero is a human (+1 to all). They are final once you save or leave the first safe room.
level.style.title: Fighting style
level.style.hint: Pick one; point at a style to read what it does.
level.save.hint: Saving makes your scores and style final.
level.waiting: Take the choice of the level before first.

level.improve.hint: Give 2 points to your abilities (+2 to one or +1 to two, none above 20), or take a feat instead.
level.improve.feats: Or take a feat (point at one to read it):
intro.part1:
Beneath the jagged peaks of the Carpathians lies a land suffocated by an endless nightmare.

Every full moon, as the church bells toll midnight, a suffocating dread settles over the valleys. From the ancient, brooding castle atop the cliffside, tides of risen dead pour out into the surrounding realms, leaving butchered villages and silent graveyards in their wake.

No army can breach the fortress walls. High ladders rot before they touch the stone, and siege engines shatter against a towering, ethereal barrier of dark magic that seals the castle grounds from the outside world.

There is only one way in.
intro.part2:
A league away, a gaping chasm cuts into the frozen earth—the mouth of a labyrinthine dungeon stretching deep beneath the mountains. It is through these sunken corridors that the undead emerge, and it is the only physical passage into the fortress above.

The local magistrate, desperate and running out of time, has put out a final plea for aid. The last party of sellswords sent into the abyss never returned.

Now, the contract falls to you. Descend into the subterranean darkness, fight through the teeming horrors in the depths, reach the high spires of the castle, and destroy the dark necromancer before the next moon rises.

spell.fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
spell.fire_bolt.description: A mote of fire hurled at a foe: a spell attack for 1d10 fire damage.
spell.ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
spell.ray_of_frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light: a spell attack for 1d8 cold damage.
spell.chill_touch.name: Chill Touch
spell.chill_touch.description: A ghostly, skeletal hand that clings to a foe: a spell attack for 1d8 necrotic damage.
spell.chromatic_orb.name: Chromatic Orb
spell.chromatic_orb.description: A sphere of raw energy: a spell attack for 3d8 acid damage. Slow to recover.
spell.magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
spell.magic_missile.description: Three glowing darts of force that never miss: 1d4+1 force damage each.
spell.burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
spell.burning_hands.description: A sheet of flame where you aim, close by: everyone in it saves on DEX against your spell DC or takes 3d6 fire damage (half on a success).
spell.thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
spell.thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you: everyone near saves on CON against your spell DC or takes 2d8 thunder damage (half on a success).
spell.cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
spell.cure_wounds.description: A touch of healing light: you regain 1d8 + your casting ability in hit points.
spell.eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
spell.eldritch_blast.description: A beam of crackling energy: a spell attack for 1d10 force damage.
spell.arms_of_hadar.name: Arms of Hadar
spell.arms_of_hadar.description: Tentacles of dark energy lash out around you: everyone near saves on STR against your spell DC or takes 2d6 necrotic damage (half on a success).
spell.vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
spell.vicious_mockery.description: A string of insults laced with magic, aimed close by: everyone in it saves on WIS against your spell DC or takes 1d4 psychic damage (half on a success).
spell.healing_word.name: Healing Word
spell.healing_word.description: A word of healing power: you regain 1d4 + your casting ability in hit points, and it recovers faster than Cure Wounds.
spell.sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
spell.sacred_flame.description: Radiance falls where you aim, close by: everyone in it saves on DEX against your spell DC or takes 1d8 radiant damage (half on a success).
spell.guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
spell.guiding_bolt.description: A flash of light streaks at a foe: a spell attack for 4d6 radiant damage. Slow to recover.

Type commands with a slash in front, like /this

console.help:
All commands
------------
/help : this list
/money <amount> : adds coins to your purse (also /give money <amount>)
/god [on|off] : toggles taking no harm
/xp <amount> : adds experience (levels up as it goes)
/additem <id> : puts an item in your bag, e.g. /additem weapon_axe_001
/items [filter] : lists item ids
console.slash: Type commands with a slash in front, like /help
